sourcePolicy: Manager, agency, municipal, and operator sources establish current access and rules. Route guides and paddler organizations corroborate use and identify hazards. No land manager was contacted.

sources.site: Grace Dam Bridge / Grace Dam Road
sources.label: Idaho Fish and Game: Bear River Black Canyon guidance
sources.evidenceUse: Fishery access context; route/control already cite PacifiCorp's recreation plan for the named below-dam facility and hand launch.

sources.label: NYSDEC Public Access to New York Marine Waters
sources.evidenceUse: Current DEC public waterway-access listing includes Mattituck Creek.

sources.label: New York State Parks Boat Launch Sites
sources.evidenceUse: Lists Mattituck Creek (SW), Naugles Road and a hard-surface ramp.

sources.label: Village of Kimberly 2025 Program Guide
sources.evidenceUse: Identifies the boat/kayak launch at 300 Sunset Park Drive, west entrance, and the published daily/annual fee schedule.

sources.label: Village of Kimberly Code §372-7
sources.evidenceUse: Confirms a parking fee requirement for boat-trailer users and self-registration.

sources.label: Guthrie County Lenon Mill Park
sources.evidenceUse: County park page identifies canoe access on the Middle Raccoon River.

sources.label: Iowa DNR Middle/South Raccoon River Water Trail guide
sources.evidenceUse: Names the Lenon Mill-to-P-28 water-trail section and access chain.

sources.label: Town of Turtle public information page
sources.evidenceUse: Lists Resolution 2026-11, titled Temporary Restrictions of Activities on Turtle Creek, and names the Turtle Canoe Launch on South Creek Road as a notice-posting location. Page text does not expose the resolution body or scope.

sources.label: Wisconsin DNR Turtle Creek Wildlife Area
sources.evidenceUse: Supports canoe/kayak use, public parking, and primitive launch context in the area; it does not resolve the Town's current restriction notice.

sources.label: NYSDEC Paul Smiths College Conservation Easement Tract
sources.evidenceUse: Names the hand launch, its road access, and access to Osgood Pond and Osgood River.

sources.label: NYSDEC Debar Mountain Wild Forest
sources.evidenceUse: Confirms Osgood Pond hand-launch access and publishes a separate parking-area point; no substitution was made because it is not the launch toe.

sources.label: USFS Boise National Forest management plan
sources.evidenceUse: Identifies Troutdale as a developed campground in the Middle Fork Boise corridor; does not publish a current launch-toe coordinate.

sources.label: American Whitewater Idaho river index
sources.evidenceUse: Lists Troutdale-to-Willow and Troutdale-to-Badger reaches; route coordinates are treated as approximate access-area context.

sources.site: Red’s Twilight on the Erie RV Resort
sources.label: Resort accommodations
sources.evidenceUse: Documents lodging options, not paddler launch or public canal-entry permission.

sources.label: Missouri Department of Conservation park page
sources.evidenceUse: Confirms cooperative public park, boating subject to posted rules, and park access context.

sources.label: MDC Van Buren Riverfront Park area map
sources.evidenceUse: Depicts the boat ramp and parking; stored route point remains an access-area anchor.

sources.label: Grand Teton National Park Deadmans Bar
sources.evidenceUse: Confirms canoe/kayak launch, parking, toilet, permit, and AIS inspection requirements.
